import React from 'react'; import { Helmet } from 'react-helmet'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; const PestControlCostChennai = () => (
Pest Control Cost in Chennai 2025 | Transparent Pricing Guide

Pest Control Cost in Chennai 2025: Complete Pricing Guide

When faced with a pest infestation, many Chennai residents ask the same question: "How much will professional pest control cost?" The answer isn't always straightforward because pricing depends on several factors—infestation severity, property size, treatment type, and location. This guide breaks down pest control costs in Chennai, helping you make an informed decision.

Service Pricing Breakdown

🐭 Rodent Control

Single Visit

₹799-1,500

Package (4 visits)

₹2,500-5,000

  • • Includes inspection and treatment
  • • Duration: 30-60 minutes
  • • Warranty: 3-6 months

🪳 Cockroach Control

Single Visit

₹999-1,999

Package (3 visits)

₹2,500-5,500

  • • Safe for children and pets
  • • Duration: 45-90 minutes
  • • Warranty: 6-12 months

2. Infestation Severity

  • Mild: Few signs, early detection — ₹800-1,500 (single treatment may suffice)
  • Moderate: Multiple areas affected — ₹2,000-4,000 (3-4 visits over 2 months)
  • Severe: Widespread infestation — ₹4,000-8,000+ (extended treatment plan)

3. Pest Type

Different pests require different treatment approaches:

  • • Cockroaches: Moderate difficulty — ₹999-1,999
  • • Rodents: Easy to moderate — ₹799-1,500
  • • Termites: Complex (requires structural treatment) — ₹1,499-3,999
  • • Mosquitoes: Seasonal/recurring — ₹500-1,000

Seasonal Pricing Variations

Pest activity varies seasonally in Chennai. Understanding this helps you time your treatment for best results:

Monsoon (July-September)

Peak termite season. Prices may increase 10-15% due to demand. Pre-monsoon treatment is cost-effective.

Summer (March-June)

Moderate pest activity. Standard pricing applies. Good time to get preventive treatment.

Winter (December-February)

Lower pest activity. Budget-friendly season for treatment. Effective timing for prevention.
